status: static compatibility evidence, not complete runtime validation
evidence_type: LLVM/ipsw static artifact inspection; no REA Evidence ID (REA Mach-O provider requires macOS)
dyld_false_positive: VA0x66274 contains SHA256 round constant0x78a5636f; linear sweep decoded embedded data as LDUMAXAH
springboard_wrapper_limitation: The app binary branches into SpringBoard.framework in the shared cache.
kernel_capability_source: osfmk/arm/commpage/commpage.c: kHasFeatLSE derives from ID_AA64ISAR0_EL1.Atomic; cpu_capabilities.h defines bit0x02000000
inference: An A53 with no LSE must receive a clear LSE commpage capability, allowing the examined Apple resolver to choose its existing LL/SC implementation. Presence of LSE variants alone does not prove incompatibility.
limitations: This is a bounded instruction-family scan, not complete ISA validation.
Only launchd, dyld, SpringBoard.framework and four core libraries were scanned; dependencies and remaining cached images were not all checked.
Reachability of all optimized private helpers was not proven.
CPU model / crypto feature compatibility and correct dispatch require runtime testing.
Static absence of mnemonic candidates does not establish successful boot.
local_evidence_directory: references (workspace sibling of xnu; excluded from source repository)
